author: roforcer
quote:
Technically the game very impressive, but that's where the positive end.
The characters are crazy boring and lack charisma, same for the story line. Gameplay often boring and stretched for no reason, just wasting my time pressing some buttons doing meditation... in GTA!!! There is some hilarious random stuff on the game periphery in random encounters, but the core story and characters are pathetic compared to previous GTA games, like it was made by someone with 0 testosterone and sense of humor
